article.title: Displaced Chagossians are among victims of Iran war
article.author: Jeremy Kuzmarov
article.content: The Trump administration is blocking an agreement that would allow Chagossians who were displaced 60 years ago to return to their homeland. The post Displaced Chagossians are among victims of Iran war appeared first on MR Online .
